text:
alex: Heads-up: cost spike on SIEM hot indices. I want to shorten hot retention from 180d -> 90d. Need to lock down who can pull raw exports after this change. @maria @jordan

maria: Shorter hot retention sounds fine but we must preserve investigators' ability to reproduce incidents. We need a JIT export process + stricter roles.

jordan: Suggest two role splits: `siem_query` (can run queries, no export), `siem_exporter` (can request/perform exports via approval). No permanent wide read.

eve: Agree. Also: put exported snapshots into a cold GCS archive encrypted with CMK and require CMK unwrap logs for access. Automate stamping of ticket id into export metadata.

alex: Draft ticket template idea:```
Title: SIEM export request - <reason>
Scope: <indices, time-range, tenant>
Duration: <24h|72h|other>
Approver: <security oncall>
CMK unwrap required: <yes/no>
```
Keep it short.

maria: Policy: block any export pipeline run that does not include a valid ticket id. OPA rule to enforce. Also remove `siem_reader` from broad platform-admin groups.

jordan: How to audit unwraps: KMS should emit an immutable event with actor, key_id, and ticket id. security-bot: KMS unwrap event recorded -> key=rlw-prod-1, actor=jordan, ticket=SEC-821

eve: Export pipeline should (a) validate ticket via ticket API, (b) inject ticket id into object metadata, (c) write manifest with hash and minimal PII, (d) upload wrapped by CMK.

alex: CMK rotation concern: rotating keys often makes re-decryption of archives harder. Proposed cadence?

maria: Annually rotate CMKs. Keep rotation metadata in the archive manifest. For emergency rotation, use key-escrow that requires multi-sig approval.

jordan: Proposed gating flow:
1) Request created with selectors + justification
2) Security oncall approves within SLA (3 business hours)
3) Approver triggers ephemeral KMS grant / unwrap (logged)
4) Pipeline stamps ticket id + approver, uploads wrapped snapshot to cold archive
5) Post-export review entry created if sensitive content detected

eve: Who retains permanent access to cold archives? I propose: legal, forensics team, security SRE lead. Access via time-limited IAM bindings after request & audit.

alex: How long keep manifests? Compliance says keep audit artifacts longer. Thoughts?

maria: Keep manifests 7 years, but redact/minimize PII fields. Manifests are audit-only and should be signed.

jordan: Implementation tasks:
- TF module to create exporter role + time-limited bindings
- Cloud Function to validate tickets and stamp exports
- OPA policy to deny unstamped exports

eve: I'll write the ticket template + an archive access runbook.

ops-bot: CI queued: export-stamp-service v0.4 -> staging

alex: Action items:
- maria: RBAC role definitions + policy snippets (EOD)
- jordan: PR for stamp service + OPA rule (tomorrow)
- eve: ticket template + access runbook (next week)
- security: finalize CMK rotation & escrow docs

security-bot: Reminder: KMS unwraps without ticket id will be rejected by policy as of rollout.

alex: Thanks all — ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
